blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & General Requirements

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈1788〉 與相關章節（〈787〉、〈788〉、〈789〉）之間的關係與定位
blocks.en: Understand how USP <1788> relates to, and is positioned against, the related chapters (<787>, <788>, <789>)

blocks.zh: 區分三種微粒分析方法的原理：光阻法 (LO)、薄膜顯微法 (MM)、流動成像法 (FI)
blocks.en: Distinguish the principles of the three particle analysis methods: light obscuration (LO), membrane microscopy (MM) and flow imaging (FI)

blocks.zh: 掌握亞可見微粒的三種分類：外源性 (extrinsic)、內源性 (intrinsic)、固有性 (inherent)
blocks.en: Master the three categories of subvisible particles: extrinsic, intrinsic and inherent

blocks.zh: 瞭解各方法的適用範圍、限制與選擇依據
blocks.en: Understand the scope, limitations and selection criteria of each method

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 法定限量標準（Table 2）及風險導向的粒子管控策略
blocks.en: Understand the USP compendial limits (Table 2) and the risk-based approach to particle control

blocks.zh: 1. Introduction | 簡介
blocks.en: 1. Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — USP 章節體系
blocks.en: Core Concept: The USP Chapter Framework

blocks.zh: 〈1788〉 的定位：這是一個「資訊性」章節（informational chapter），不直接設定法規限量，而是作為法規章節 〈787〉/〈788〉/〈789〉 的技術支援與補充說明。
blocks.en: Role of <1788>: This is an informational chapter. It does not set regulatory limits itself; it provides technical support and supplementary explanation for the compendial chapters <787>/<788>/<789>.

blocks.zh: 章節層級結構：
blocks.en: Chapter hierarchy:

blocks.zh: 〈787〉 — 治療性蛋白質注射劑，有法規限量
blocks.en: <787>: therapeutic protein injections, with compendial limits

blocks.zh: 〈788〉 — 注射劑通用章（諧調章），有法規限量
blocks.en: <788>: general chapter for injections (harmonized), with compendial limits

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 — 眼科溶液，更嚴格限量
blocks.en: <789>: ophthalmic solutions, with stricter limits

blocks.zh: 〈1787〉 — 蛋白質製品亞可見微粒，資訊性
blocks.en: <1787>: subvisible particles in protein products, informational

blocks.zh: 〈1788〉 — 方法學詳細指引，本章
blocks.en: <1788>: detailed methodological guidance (this chapter)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 三種微粒就像廚房裡的異物
blocks.en: Analogy: The Three Particle Types as Foreign Objects in the Kitchen

blocks.zh: 想像一鍋湯（藥品）裡的異物：
blocks.en: Imagine foreign matter in a pot of soup (the drug product):

blocks.zh: 外源性 Extrinsic (外源性微粒)：蒼蠅從外飛入——來自外部環境，代表生產環境或無菌控制的失敗
blocks.en: Extrinsic particles: A fly that flew in from outside. It comes from the external environment and signals a failure of the manufacturing environment or of aseptic control.

blocks.zh: 內源性 Intrinsic (內源性微粒)：鍋子或容器脫落的碎片——來自製程、設備、容器密封系統
blocks.en: Intrinsic particles: Flakes shed from the pot or container. They come from the process, the equipment or the container closure system.

blocks.zh: 固有性 Inherent (固有性微粒)：豆漿本身的豆渣——是產品配方本身的特性，如蛋白質自聚集
blocks.en: Inherent particles: The soy pulp in soy milk. It is a characteristic of the product formulation itself, such as protein self-aggregation.

blocks.zh: 三者的風險等級不同，管控策略也不同。
blocks.en: The three carry different levels of risk, so the control strategies differ as well.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 三種分析方法的本質差異
blocks.en: Key Point: The Fundamental Differences Between the Three Analytical Methods

blocks.zh: LO（光阻法）：自動化、高通量；但無法區分固體/液滴/氣泡，低折射率粒子（如蛋白聚集體）會被低估
blocks.en: LO (light obscuration): Automated and high-throughput, but it cannot distinguish solids from droplets or bubbles, and low-refractive-index particles (such as protein aggregates) are undercounted.

blocks.zh: MM（薄膜顯微法）：可保存微粒供後續鑑定；但費工費時，不適合矽油或蛋白聚集體
blocks.en: MM (membrane microscopy): Particles are retained for later identification, but the method is labor-intensive and time-consuming, and it is not suitable for silicone oil or protein aggregates.

blocks.zh: FI（流動成像法）：拍攝每個粒子的影像，形態學資訊豐富；但尚未納入 〈788〉 法規限量
blocks.en: FI (flow imaging): Captures an image of every particle and gives rich morphological information, but it has not yet been incorporated into the <788> compendial limits.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FI 目前不包含在 〈788〉 法規限量中？列出原文提到的三個理由。
blocks.en: Why is FI currently not included in the <788> compendial limits? List the three reasons given in the original text.

blocks.zh: 一個蛋白質藥品在 LO 測試超標，但 MM 結果正常，最可能的原因是什麼？
blocks.en: A protein drug product fails the LO test but passes MM. What is the most likely cause?

blocks.zh: 2. Scope | 適用範圍
blocks.en: 2. Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 正交方法 (Orthogonal Methods)
blocks.en: Core Concept: Orthogonal Methods

blocks.zh: Orthogonal Methods（正交方法）：使用原理不同、測量維度互補的方法同時進行分析，以獲得更全面的理解。就像對同一個物體同時拍攝正面照、X光、和切片——每種方法看到不同面向。
blocks.en: Orthogonal methods: Analyzing a sample with methods that work on different principles and measure complementary attributes, in order to gain a more complete understanding. It is like photographing one object from the front, by X-ray and in cross-section: each method shows a different aspect.

blocks.zh: 在微粒分析中：LO 告訴你「有多少粒子」，MM 告訴你「長什麼樣」，FI 告訴你「每個粒子的形狀和顏色」。三者結合才是完整的認識。
blocks.en: In particle analysis, LO tells you how many particles there are, MM tells you what they look like, and FI tells you the shape and color of each individual particle. Only the three together give the complete picture.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 為什麼 10 µm 是關鍵門檻？
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Is 10 µm the Critical Threshold?

blocks.zh: USP 限量以 ≥10 µm 為基準，源於 1970–1980 年代的歷史臨床經驗，並非直接證明 10 µm 以下對患者安全的影響。
blocks.en: The USP limits are based on ≥10 µm, which originates from clinical experience in the 1970s and 1980s. It is not direct proof of the effect on patients of particles smaller than 10 µm.

blocks.zh: 現代觀點認為，對於生物製劑（尤其是蛋白質藥品），2–10 µm 的次可見微粒也可能引發免疫原性，因此 〈787〉 和 〈1787〉 建議擴大偵測範圍至 ≥2 µm。
blocks.en: The modern view is that for biologics (especially protein drug products), subvisible particles of 2–10 µm may also trigger immunogenicity, which is why <787> and <1787> recommend extending the detection range to ≥2 µm.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 為什麼不直接把 FI 納入法規？
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Not Simply Put FI into the Compendial Limits?

blocks.zh: 就像一項新的駕照考試科目（例如夜間道路考試），雖然技術上更能評估駕駛能力，但要納入正式法規需要：全國統一標準、大量歷史資料、考官培訓。FI 目前就處於這個「很有潛力但還沒標準化」的階段。
blocks.en: Think of a new subject in the driving test, such as a night-time road test. It would technically assess driving ability better, but making it part of the formal rules requires nationwide uniform standards, a large body of historical data and trained examiners. FI is currently at exactly this stage: very promising but not yet standardized.

blocks.zh: 〈788〉 是「諧調章節（harmonized chapter）」，這對新增 FI 方法有什麼影響？
blocks.en: <788> is a harmonized chapter. What does this mean for adding FI as a method?

blocks.zh: 你的公司打算開發一個蛋白質藥品，應該參考哪些 USP 章節？
blocks.en: Your company plans to develop a protein drug product. Which USP chapters should you refer to?

blocks.zh: 3. Background | 背景知識
blocks.en: 3. Background

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — LO 的系統性偏差
blocks.en: Core Concept: Systematic Bias of LO

blocks.zh: LO 測量的是粒子「遮蔽光線的截面積」，因此：
blocks.en: LO measures the cross-sectional area with which a particle blocks light, so:

blocks.zh: 球形粒子：測量準確
blocks.en: Spherical particles: Measured accurately.

blocks.zh: 纖維狀粒子：回報的等效圓徑偏向纖維寬度，而非長度（高估）
blocks.en: Fibrous particles: The reported equivalent circular diameter reflects the fiber width rather than its length (overestimated).

blocks.zh: 低折射率粒子（如蛋白聚集體）：遮光效果差，被低估
blocks.en: Low-refractive-index particles (such as protein aggregates): Poor light obscuration, so they are undercounted.

blocks.zh: 矽油液滴/氣泡：被計入粒子數，但並非固體異物
blocks.en: Silicone oil droplets/air bubbles: Counted as particles even though they are not solid foreign matter.

blocks.zh: 這些偏差不是儀器故障，而是 LO 方法的物理原理所致，必須在方法驗證中加以評估。
blocks.en: These biases are not instrument malfunctions. They follow from the physical principle of the LO method and must be assessed during method validation.

blocks.zh: 公式概念 — 折射率 (Refractive Index, RI) 與偵測靈敏度
blocks.en: Formula Concept: Refractive Index (RI) and Detection Sensitivity

blocks.zh:
偵測靈敏度 ∝ |RI粒子 - RI溶液|

水的 RI ≈ 1.33
矽油的 RI ≈ 1.40
蛋白聚集體的 RI ≈ 1.35 (差值僅 ~0.02)

→ 蛋白聚集體的 LO 信號很弱，
  容易被低估或低於偵測極限
blocks.en:
Detection sensitivity ∝ |RI particle - RI solution|

RI of water ≈ 1.33
RI of silicone oil ≈ 1.40
RI of protein aggregates ≈ 1.35 (difference only ~0.02)

→ The LO signal of protein aggregates is weak,
  so they are easily undercounted or fall below the detection limit

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 微粒三分類的實際意義
blocks.en: Analogy: The Practical Meaning of the Three Particle Categories

blocks.zh: 比喻為餐廳食安管理：
blocks.en: Think of food safety management in a restaurant:

blocks.zh: 外源性：客人帶進來的泥土（環境污染）→ 代表 GMP 環境失控，最嚴重
blocks.en: Extrinsic: Dirt brought in by a customer (environmental contamination). It signals that the GMP environment is out of control and is the most serious.

blocks.zh: 內源性：廚師刮下的鍋鏽（設備/容器污染）→ 代表製程設計問題，需工程改善
blocks.en: Intrinsic: Rust scraped off a pot by the cook (equipment/container contamination). It signals a process design problem that needs engineering improvement.

blocks.zh: 固有性：燉肉本身的蛋白泡沫（產品特性）→ 不可避免，需科學論證其可接受性
blocks.en: Inherent: The protein foam on a stew (a product characteristic). It is unavoidable, so its acceptability must be justified scientifically.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 蛋白質免疫原性的監管挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: The Regulatory Challenge of Protein Immunogenicity

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥品（如單株抗體、融合蛋白）的聚集體可能誘發患者的免疫反應（抗藥抗體，ADA），不只影響療效，更可能危及生命（嚴重超敏反應）。
blocks.en: Aggregates of protein drug products (such as monoclonal antibodies and fusion proteins) can trigger an immune response in patients (anti-drug antibodies, ADA). This can affect efficacy and may even be life-threatening (severe hypersensitivity reactions).

blocks.zh: 這正是為什麼 〈787〉 對蛋白質藥品有更嚴格的要求，也是為什麼在藥品開發早期就必須建立全面的微粒分析策略。
blocks.en: This is exactly why <787> sets stricter requirements for protein drug products, and why a comprehensive particle analysis strategy must be established early in drug development.

blocks.zh: 如果一個碳酸氫鈉緩衝液配方在 LO 測試中顯示異常高計數，最可能的原因是什麼？如何排除這個問題？
blocks.en: If a sodium bicarbonate buffer formulation shows an abnormally high count in the LO test, what is the most likely cause, and how can it be ruled out?

blocks.zh: 蛋白質疫苗的微粒監控策略為何與蛋白質治療藥物不同？
blocks.en: How does the particle monitoring strategy for protein vaccines differ from that for protein therapeutics?

blocks.zh: 4. Detection and Enumeration of Particles | 粒子偵測與計數  |  5. Applicability of Methods | 方法適用性
blocks.en: 4. Detection and Enumeration of Particles | 5. Applicability of Methods

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 粒子尺寸連續體
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Particle Size Continuum

blocks.zh: 微粒依尺寸可分為四個區域：
blocks.en: By size, particles fall into four zones:

blocks.zh: 奈米粒子（Nanoparticles）：<2 µm——需要 DLS、NTA 等特殊技術
blocks.en: Nanoparticles: <2 µm. These require special techniques such as DLS and NTA.

blocks.zh: 亞可見微粒（Subvisible）：2–100 µm——LO/MM/FI 的主要偵測範圍
blocks.en: Subvisible: 2–100 µm. The main detection range of LO/MM/FI.

blocks.zh: 灰色地帶（Visible Gray Zone）：50–200 µm——人眼偵測概率性，不可靠
blocks.en: Visible gray zone: 50–200 µm. Detection by the human eye is probabilistic and unreliable.

blocks.zh: 可見微粒（Visible）：>100–200 µm——目視檢查 〈790〉
blocks.en: Visible: >100–200 µm. Covered by visual inspection, <790>.

blocks.zh: 法規限量集中在 ≥10 µm 和 ≥25 µm，但完整的品質控制策略應覆蓋更廣的尺寸範圍。
blocks.en: The compendial limits focus on ≥10 µm and ≥25 µm, but a complete quality control strategy should cover a wider size range.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 方法選擇的決策邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: Decision Logic for Method Selection

blocks.zh: 選擇微粒分析方法的決策流程：
blocks.en: Decision flow for selecting a particle analysis method:

blocks.zh: 產品是否清澈、低黏度、無色？→ Yes: LO 作為主要方法
blocks.en: Is the product clear, low-viscosity and colorless? → Yes: use LO as the primary method.

blocks.zh: 產品有顏色或高黏度？→ 考慮 MM 或方法修改
blocks.en: Is the product colored or highly viscous? → Consider MM or a method modification.

blocks.zh: 是乳劑或懸浮劑？→ 可能無法直接測試，需先分離
blocks.en: Is it an emulsion or a suspension? → It may not be possible to test it directly; separation is needed first.

blocks.zh: 是蛋白質藥品？→ 加入 FI 作為正交方法，評估聚集體
blocks.en: Is it a protein drug product? → Add FI as an orthogonal method to evaluate aggregates.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 方法比較如同不同類型的安檢
blocks.en: Analogy: Comparing the Methods Is Like Different Types of Security Screening

blocks.zh: 機場安全檢查有多種設備：X 光機（快速掃描行李，像 LO）、人工開箱檢查（仔細審查，像 MM）、3D 全身掃描儀（完整影像，像 FI）。沒有一種方法是萬能的，組合使用才能達到最高安全保障。
blocks.en: Airport security uses several kinds of equipment: an X-ray machine (scans baggage quickly, like LO), a manual bag search (careful examination, like MM) and a 3D body scanner (a complete image, like FI). No single method is universal; only a combination gives the highest level of assurance.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 方法開發策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Method Development Strategy

blocks.zh: 在接受客戶的新品種時，CDMO 應根據產品特性制定分析方法策略：
blocks.en: When taking on a new product from a client, a CDMO should define the analytical method strategy according to the product characteristics:

blocks.zh: 若為清澈小分子：直接採用標準 LO 方法，快速放行
blocks.en: Clear small-molecule product: use the standard LO method directly, for fast release.

blocks.zh: 若為蛋白質藥品：必須建立 LO + FI 雙方法，評估聚集體的 RI 影響
blocks.en: Protein drug product: establish both LO and FI methods and evaluate the effect of the aggregate RI.

blocks.zh: 若為眼藥水：需符合 〈789〉 的更嚴格限量（含 ≥50 µm 門檻）
blocks.en: Ophthalmic solution: must meet the stricter limits of <789> (including the ≥50 µm threshold).

blocks.zh: 若為懸浮劑：需做方法開發研究（稀釋、相分離），才能套用任何方法
blocks.en: Suspension: method development studies (dilution, phase separation) are needed before any method can be applied.

blocks.zh: 查閱 Table 1，MM 方法的樣品體積範圍遠大於 LO，這在什麼情況下是優勢？
blocks.en: Looking at Table 1, the sample volume range for MM is much larger than that for LO. In what situations is this an advantage?

blocks.zh: 如果你的製造線上有多個灌裝泵，為什麼要對每個泵分別評估微粒負荷？
blocks.en: If your manufacturing line has several filling pumps, why should the particle load of each pump be evaluated separately?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 〈1788〉 是資訊性章節，補充說明 LO、MM、FI 三種方法，支援法規性的 〈787〉/〈788〉/〈789〉 章節
blocks.en: <1788> is an informational chapter that supplements the three methods LO, MM and FI and supports the compendial chapters <787>/<788>/<789>.

blocks.zh: 微粒分三類：外源性（環境）、內源性（製程/容器）、固有性（產品特性）；各有不同的風險含義與管控策略
blocks.en: Particles fall into three categories: extrinsic (environment), intrinsic (process/container) and inherent (product characteristics). Each carries a different risk implication and control strategy.

blocks.zh: LO 是首選且最自動化的方法，但對低折射率粒子、氣泡、矽油液滴有系統性偏差；FI 提供形態學資訊；MM 可保存粒子供後續鑑定
blocks.en: LO is the preferred and most automated method, but it has systematic bias for low-refractive-index particles, air bubbles and silicone oil droplets. FI provides morphological information, and MM retains particles for later identification.

blocks.zh: USP 法規限量以 ≥10 µm 為門檻，但完整的品質控制尤其對生物製劑應擴展到 ≥2 µm 的範圍
blocks.en: The USP compendial limits use ≥10 µm as the threshold, but complete quality control, especially for biologics, should extend to the ≥2 µm range.

blocks.zh: 沒有任何單一方法可以解決所有問題；正交測試策略是藥品開發的最佳實踐
blocks.en: No single method solves every problem; an orthogonal testing strategy is best practice in drug development.
